layout: Use one flat metadata array per page file stored under projects/.
Keep Bootstrap container -> row -> column as the only layout system.
Prefer one row per section and group related leaves inside shared columns.
classes: Use only verified runtime/component utility classes from the allowlist.
Strip any legacy c~ prefix before persisting class names.
Use component props for appearance and wrapper utilities for spacing/layout.
children: container children must be rows; row children must be columns.
card uses header/body/footer slot arrays; tab uses keyed child arrays.
panel, accordion, Div, and form use flat children arrays.
patterns: Use d-flex only on columns that directly arrange non-row children.
Do not create repeated Row > Col wrappers for simple heading/paragraph/action stacks.
Keep designer compatibility fields in generated nodes.
reactSubset: Round-trip React must stay inside Bootstrap wrappers + current Nb* components + approved utilities.
No custom CSS modules or custom visual inline styles in React prototypes.
Prototype the same wrapper tree you intend to save as UIDL.
saveImport: Local authored files are bare metadata arrays with no pageId.
Designer import/export uses a wrapped bundle with pageId, metadata, and optional query data.
API save uses { pageId, metadata: JSON.stringify({ pageInfo, metadata, queryEvents }) }.
